LESSON: READING 4.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION - VISUALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals, part of Strand 4 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why are visuals used in communication? 2. How do we conserve the environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. study the pictures and make observations about environmental conservation,

2. infer the implied meaning from a variety of visuals,

3. conduct a reader’s theatre to read texts on environmental conservation,

4. create a personal glossary of vocabulary related to environmental conservation,

5. work jointly to summarise information from the text into a visual (e.g. picture, charts, graph)

6. team up to collect a collection of visuals on the theme and organise them in a class portfolio. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. study the pictures and make observations about environmental conservation,
2. infer the implied meaning from a variety of visuals,
3. conduct a reader’s theatre to read texts on environmental conservation,
4. create a personal glossary of vocabulary related to environmental conservation,
5. work jointly to summarise information from the text into a visual (e.g. picture, charts, graph)
6. team up to collect a collection of visuals on the theme and organise them in a class portfolio. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: This is developed as the learner consolidates information when reading texts and studying pictures to

make observations about environmental conservation.

• Learning to Learn: This is cultivated as the learner is motivated to learn continuously by reading about environmental

conservation to create a glossary.

Values:
• Respect: This is promoted as the learner appreciates diverse opinions when listening to peers’ interpretation of

vocabulary items.

• Unity: This is developed as the learner works with peers to discuss environmental issues in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education is promoted as the learner reads texts with information on environmental conservation.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of creating visuals to their learning in Creative Arts and Sports.
